nesting_inference.evidence: back edges targeting offset 560 (cycle_count=0, e.g. from_offset 2842) and the cluster of back edges from offsets 6321/6349/6380/6396/6425 to offset 2804 (near the collision switch) represent the compiled, block-layout-reordered top of this loop.
nesting_inference.confidence: inference -- GCC -O2 basic block reordering scatters the literal source-order loop header across several back-edge targets; the exact single 'the' back edge for the per-frame loop could not be isolated with certainty in the time budget.

nesting_inference.description: 'Restart game' outer loop: after death/results/replay-save flow, control jumps back into the function's own setup_prologue to begin another round without returning to the caller.
nesting_inference.evidence: back edges from offsets 10162/10175/10226 (jne/je/jmp) to offset 258 (inside setup_prologue, after the zero-global block) and from offset 10272 (jmp) to offset 87 (inside the per-history-array zeroing loop).
nesting_inference.confidence: high -- these are the only back edges targeting the prologue region, and the region at their source (10261-10595, labeled setup_prologue) independently re-executes the timer bootstrap calls seen in the real prologue (clock/QueryPerformanceFrequency/QueryPerformanceCounter/time).

nesting_inference.description: Inner busy-wait / pause-confirmation loops (e.g. 'while (is_pause(&ctrl) && !closeButtonClicked) { poll_control(...); rest(2); }' and the death-screen 'wait for key' loops).
nesting_inference.confidence: inference -- grouped by proximity to poll_control/is_pause/rest call sites, not individually traced instruction-by-instruction.

nesting_inference.description: Remaining ~195 back edges are short (typically under 100 bytes) and consistent with GCC -O2 jump-threading of if/else chains, switch-like dispatch, and loop-invariant hoisting rather than source-level loops.
nesting_inference.evidence: see loops.back_edges for the full raw list.
